entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah, your VeloFit specialist. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to make a return. Order number is VF-881-92B. Just tell me yes or no.
Of course, let me pull that up for you right now... VF-881-92B. I see the order is for an Aero Race helmet. Can I quickly ask, is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the color. It's not what I expected and doesn't match my gear. The box is unopened. I just need to send it back.
I completely understand, getting the color right is essential. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you here. I see it was delivered 28 days ago.
Okay, so can I return it or not?
Yes, you absolutely can. You are well within our 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and approved that for you. A pre-paid return label has just been sent to the email address on file.

I'm glad I could resolve that quickly. And because the original box is unopened, the process will be very fast once we receive it. We know how important safety is, and we want you to have the right helmet. I also see you're a VIP member with us, so I've added a complimentary express shipping voucher to your account for your next order.
Oh. Okay, thanks. I've got the email with the label. That's all I need.
Perfect. Thank you for your time, and for choosing VeloFit.
